evidence: Ran the skill's verify grep (judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel, plus probe|gate|grad|verif|polish|visual|functional|oracle|test) over task/instruction.md and all three /instructions notes: the only hits are the account domain '@kittle.test' in walls-and-retention.md:7-11 (seed identity data, not test paths). instruction.md (9 lines) is in the requester's voice and names no judge, rubric, dimension, weight, test path or sentinel; line 9 'please try it the way we'll use it: sign in as different people, post, reply, edit, search and open a transcript' is a natural hand-over ask, not grader machinery. Probe literals: the only judge-created sentinels are JUDGE-CS1, JUDGE-WL1, JUDGE-R1B (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:43-44,79,89,91) and 'JUDGE messages' (functional/prompt.md:71); grep for JUDGE/probe over instruction.md, environment/ (notes, kittle.json, Dockerfile) and solution/ finds none. Criterion ids: all 27 ids across gates/scored judge.toml (e.g. signin_and_client_scope, wall_every_route, persistence, timer_label, phone_chambers, server_backed_local_application) were grepped as whole words in the brief, notes and seed: zero hits. Dimension names (functional/polish/visual/render/constraints) do not appear. Verbatim overlap: token 8-gram comparison of brief+notes against every criterion description and every prompt.md/app_context.md found only (a) the 12-token account table in app_context.md (shared seed fact) and (b) two 8-token phrases where criteria quote public requirements ('shows a short preview of the linked message', conversations.md:17; 'typing the words On hold into a message', conversations.md:13). Neither is long overlap nor a leak of grading text into the brief. Agent image (environment/Dockerfile) copies only instructions/ and assets/; no tests/ or solution/ path. Frozen file hashes for instruction.md and the three notes equal manifest.json entries. Adversarial: a weak app cannot exploit any leaked sentinel or criterion boundary because none is published; a conforming alternative is not steered toward grader-specific UI (the notes state product rules such as 'not available', 390 px, five-second live updates with user reasons, which are graded requirements rather than grader mechanics). Static row; no runtime evidence is required and none was claimed. Distinct from row 16/deterministic check-instruction-hygiene.py, which I did not execute (manual application only).
